instruction: An action candid medium close-up shot on a yellow tatami mat. The young man with short dark hair (R2) in a white judo gi stands over his opponent, executing a throw. He firmly grips the opponent's white gi collar with his right hand, pulling him downward. In the foreground, a bystander with wavy light brown hair in a white gi is bent deeply forward as he is thrown. Warm, soft lighting illuminates the clean white uniforms and the yellow floor.
